title: Reading the first bit of a block
statement: Let $x=\mathrm{pre}\,b\,\mathrm{rest}$ be a Boolean word, with $b$ a bit, and let $c$ be any configuration of a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$. One step of the augmented machine, started in its pair-reading state with the input head at position $|\mathrm{pre}|+1$, records $b$ in its parser state and moves the input head to position $|\mathrm{pre}|+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean finite Turing machine
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on Boolean input $x$
$x=\mathrm{pre}\,b\,\mathrm{rest}$ for Boolean words and a bit
